metrics_note: wait_seconds_histogram counts 20 s heavily because scenario tests pin the wait to 20 s through the fake-clock core; the real CSPRNG draw is tested separately (fallback_draw_distribution: 2,600 draws, all 26 values, chi-square). late_ms is the gap between the stored deadline and the first poll that claimed the horse; the harness polled on the 5 s heartbeat, while the API aligns a status poll to land just after the deadline. settlement_failures (12) are all deliberately injected faults from fault_injection_atomicity and the settling-state resume test (event payloads: "injected fault at decision/complete/stats/reveal"); every faulted match later settled exactly once. active (66) are matches the state, race and resume scenarios intentionally leave mid-play when the run ends; their stakes stay in escrow by design, and ledger variance on every terminal match is 0.
